_comment: Homebrew special-rules registry: rule name -> effect text (your own words). Merged into the rules index by tools/update-data.py and shown IN FULL, inline, on any unit that lists the rule name in its specialRules. Add a unit's rule by (1) adding it here, (2) listing the exact name in that unit's specialRules via a patch in the faction homebrew file. You may also add a note for an OFFICIAL rule name here in your own words — it will display inline while the official rulebook link is preserved. Do NOT paste Games Workshop's copyrighted rule text; write your own summaries. FILL-IN SHEET: every rule your army uses is listed below. Paste each effect (your words or from the free source) into its "" slot; blank slots simply show the rulebook citation link until filled.

rules.Hawk-Eyed Hunters: +1 to wound on shooting attacks when the unit has not moved this turn.
